title: Smart FORM config
description: Declarative contract for a form. A renderer reads this and nothing else; it must not need Liquid, Jekyll or Eleventy knowledge. Bump `version` only for breaking changes and add a branch to the renderer for the old one.

version.description: Schema major version. The renderer refuses anything it does not recognise.

id.description: Stable form identity. Used for DOM ids, the JSON filename and the Worker route.

steps.description: Ordered wizard steps. Every field the form submits must be reachable from here.

condition.description: One visibility/validation rule. `values` is an equality set, `value` is a comparison expression such as '>0', `except` negates.

value.description: Comparison expression, evaluated against the field's current value.

logic.description: How this entry combines with its siblings. Defaults to the enclosing group's logic.

text.description: Per-condition copy, overriding the enclosing text when this entry is the one that matched.

when.description: Gate: this entry only counts while the nested condition holds.

conditional.description: A literal value, or a value chosen by conditions. Used by min/max/pattern/required/label.

conditionalText.description: Copy that can change with the form state: a literal string, a condition list, or a default plus condition overrides.

label.description: Field label, plus the optional ⓘ link beside it. _includes/form/label.html reads exactly: depends, text, markdown, informer, icon. A plain string is the shorthand for {text}.

depends.description: When present the template renders JS-resolved copy instead of `text`, so the label can change with the form state.

informer.description: Target of the ⓘ link, shown when set. Read unescaped into an href.

icon.description: Glyph for that link. The template defaults it to ⓘ.

messages.description: Per-state user-facing copy. Overrides settings.feedback for this field.

message.description: DEAD KEY. add-property.yml:995 sets it, but no renderer reads validation.message - the fallback is the field-level `message` key instead. Kept here so existing configs validate; delete it when touching that field.

email.description: Read by the email format check, alongside settings.feedback.email.

compareMessage.description: Fallback when a validation.compare rule carries no message of its own.

minFiles.description: File field: message when fewer files were picked than file.minFiles. Supports {min}.

maxFiles.description: File field: message when more files were picked than file.maxFiles. Supports {max}.

maxSize.description: File field: message when a file is over file.maxSize. Supports {limit}.

compare.description: Cross-field rules. A `field` list means the sum of those fields.

operator.description: These six are the ones form-engine.js implements; anything else fails the rule. `===`/`!==` are deliberately absent - the legacy switch has no branch for them, so they would block every value.

message.description: Optional. Falls back to validation.compareMessage, then settings.feedback.compare.

settings.description: Form-wide defaults. Every key is optional so the same schema fits a full page form and a modal.

email.description: Form wide copy for a malformed email address.

compare.description: Form wide copy for a failed validation.compare rule.

validation.description: Per-key defaults for the whole form, read as settings.validation[defKey] by getValidationMsg. Empty in current configs, but the legacy engine reads it, so a config written there has to keep working.

submit.description: Where the collected values go. The engine never hard-codes this.

encoding.description: How the payload leaves the browser. Defaults to json; multipart is picked automatically when the form has file fields.

response.description: How the worker's reply is read back. Defaults to success.

errors.description: Worker code -> user copy. Overrides the engine's built-in map, so a form can carry its own messages in its own file.

behavior.description: How the runtime presents the form. `mode: page` runs the wizard chrome (the default); `mode: modal` runs the modal life-cycle (captcha on shown, reset on show, JSON payload).

modal.description: CSS selector of the modal element the form lives in (modal mode).

seed.description: Id of the JSON island holding page values to seed the hidden fields (modal mode).

row.description: Either a plain field row or a column split; both shapes exist in the current configs.

auto.description: Distribute the visible fields across breakpoints instead of honouring each field's `col`.

field.description: Anything the renderer draws. `additionalProperties` is open on purpose: field keys are the long tail of the DSL and grow per widget. `--strict` reports keys the renderer has never heard of.

name.description: Submission key. Must be unique across the whole form.

type.description: Widget family. The renderer's vocabulary, not just what today's configs use.

required.description: True, or conditions under which the field becomes required. The conditional form is a v1 wart; v2 splits it into `required: true` plus `depends`.

value.description: Default value drawn into the control. For type `hidden` these are set at runtime by the page glue (uid, property_url, ...), so the config usually leaves them empty.

html.description: Verbatim markup for `type: raw`. Trusted, like every config string in this DSL.

widget.description: For type `widgets`: which component to mount.

fields.description: Sub-fields of a composite widget such as the location cascade.

subField.description: A child of a composite widget. `type` is optional: the location cascade renders each level as a search input when the option count exceeds `threshold`, otherwise as a select. That is what `mode` picks between.

parent.description: Name of the sibling sub-field this one filters by. `null` at the top of the cascade.

bound.description: A numeric limit, or limit-plus-message that varies with the form state.

theme.description: Which CSS vocabulary the renderer emits. The site still has to load the matching stylesheet (Bootstrap 4 or Tailwind). Defaults to bootstrap4 when omitted.

chrome.description: Wizard chrome copy. Optional: a site adapter supplies defaults, a config overrides per form. Kept here so a form can be fully described by one file.

rates.description: Currency rates the price widgets read. Optional: a site adapter supplies defaults, a config overrides per form.

captcha.description: Cloudflare Turnstile settings, read when the config uses a captcha widget. Optional: a site adapter supplies defaults.

assets.description: Where the baked page finds its scripts and stylesheets. Optional: the site adapter supplies the defaults. Paths are read from the repository root; URLs are used as-is.
